comments_sample.author: @justinteal3443
comments_sample.text: I truly wish I could put into words how hard this version of this song hits me. It hits harder than any song I've ever heard. I can't listen to it in public because I absolutely break down when I hear it. Thank you for this version Ronnie. Thank you.

comments_sample.author: @Kwhateveryousay
comments_sample.text:
When I was 14, I slowly sank into a depression so deep that it almost killed me. 
I'd put on "The drug in me is you" when shit hit the fan... Loved it then, love it now.
Listening to this song today, without it being exactly as I last heard it, makes me very emotional : I've been through hell and out ! 
It's like I'm still me... But not exactly.

comments_sample.author: @Stangc
comments_sample.text: A lot of people dislike Ronnie but you can’t deny this isn’t one of the most, if not, beautifulest thing that we’ve ever heard.

comments_sample.author: @triune_blades
comments_sample.text: I love the string and piano additions to the reimagined and revamped songs. They're more incredible because of it.
